verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law firm with a SaaS client portal, so a sandbox or test environment is a plausible ask, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. The probes found no public API surface at all: no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
